source_research_object.title: Fiscal Choke Points: Transaction-Node Architecture and Operational Fiscal Capacity in Southeast Asian Digital Tax Administration
source_research_object.author: Christopher Ongko (王新福)
source_research_object.evidence_boundary: comparative and institutional, not causal; no country ranking or causal performance claim

proposal.recommended_title: From Visibility to Liability: Singapore’s Overseas Vendor Registration Regime and Fiscal Choke Points in Southeast Asian Digital Tax Administration
proposal.short_title: Fiscal Choke Points in Singapore’s Digital Economy
proposal.one_sentence_proposition: Test how Singapore converts commercially visible digital transactions into administrable GST obligations by assigning bounded duties to specific transaction nodes under legally defined activation conditions.
research_questions: Which actor carries each bounded GST function in Singapore's cross-border digital-economy transaction paths?
Which thresholds, belonging evidence, GST-registration states, deemed-supplier conditions, transaction classes, and control conditions activate each duty?
How tightly is fiscal action coupled to the transaction and how is it subsequently filed, corrected, refunded, audited, disputed, and enforced?
Does Singapore support, falsify, or refine the existing activation-specificity and transaction-control propositions?
Which architecture choices reduce administrative distance while preserving correction, data, privacy, and intermediary-governance constraints?

candidate_singapore_paths.object: qualifying B2C remote services and/or low-value goods
candidate_singapore_paths.activation: covered supply plus applicable global-turnover and Singapore B2C supply thresholds
candidate_singapore_paths.rail: simplified pay-only OVR registration and electronic filing

candidate_singapore_paths.node: local or overseas electronic marketplace operator
candidate_singapore_paths.object: covered B2C remote services and/or low-value goods supplied through the marketplace
candidate_singapore_paths.activation: conditions under which the electronic marketplace operator is regarded as the supplier
candidate_singapore_paths.rail: GST collection/accounting by the marketplace operator under OVR where applicable

candidate_singapore_paths.object: qualifying imported services and low-value goods
candidate_singapore_paths.activation: B2B import and incomplete entitlement to input tax recovery under applicable reverse-charge rules
admit only after the exact deemed-supplier conditions are fully source-coded

items.category: Singapore legal and administrative source expansion and verification
Practitioner validation and research support where permitted

nonclaims: No claim that the existing five-country paper identifies the revenue/compliance effect of node choice.
No claim that Singapore's architecture is superior to comparison jurisdictions.
No claim that marketplace or platform presence automatically creates tax liability.
No use of public documentation depth as a proxy for operational performance.
No causal inference from practitioner validation alone.
No claim that grant funding is required to complete the existing core manuscript.
